description: Parse canonical JSON text into a validated JSON value. Text is limited to 65536 characters, nesting is limited to depth 64, and malformed JSON, duplicate keys, non-finite numbers, cycles, or unsupported values fail before output.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts parsing when execution reaches this node.

inputs.name: json_string
inputs.description: Canonical JSON text to parse. Missing or null input uses {}. Text may contain at most 65536 characters; malformed JSON, duplicate keys, non-finite numbers, or nesting deeper than 64 fail.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the JSON value is parsed successfully.

outputs.name: object
outputs.description: Returns the validated JSON value, which may be an object, array, string, number, Boolean, or null.

description: Serialize a CanonicalJson-supported value to canonical JSON text. Character, UUID, Set, Iterable, and array shapes are coerced to JSON; cycles, non-finite numbers, values outside the canonical JSON contract, or output beyond 65536 characters fail before return.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts JSON serialization when execution reaches this node.

inputs.name: object
inputs.description: Value to serialize through CanonicalJson. Character, UUID, Set, Iterable, and array shapes are accepted; cycles, non-finite numbers, values outside the canonical JSON contract, and text over 65536 characters fail.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after canonical JSON text is produced.

outputs.name: string
outputs.description: Returns canonical JSON text no longer than 65536 characters.

description: Read a value from a JSON object using a simple dotted, object-only path. Missing keys return null; blank paths, non-object roots, traversal through non-objects, and unsupported path values fail before output.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts the JSON lookup when execution reaches this node.

inputs.name: object
inputs.description: JSON object to inspect. A non-object root fails before output, and arrays or scalar values cannot be traversed as objects.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: Simple dotted object-only path such as player.score. Blank paths and traversal through a non-object fail before output; a missing key returns null.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the lookup completes, including when the value is missing.

outputs.name: value
outputs.description: Returns the value at the dotted path, or null when a key is missing. Invalid paths fail before this output is published.

description: Check whether a JSON object contains a value at a simple dotted, object-only path. Missing keys return false; blank paths, non-object roots, traversal through non-objects, and unsupported path values fail before output.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts the JSON key check when execution reaches this node.

inputs.name: object
inputs.description: JSON object to inspect. A non-object root fails before output, and arrays or scalar values cannot be traversed as objects.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: Simple dotted object-only path such as player.score. Blank paths and traversal through a non-object fail before output; a missing key returns false.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the key check completes.

outputs.name: has
outputs.description: Reports whether the object-only dotted path exists, including when its value is null.

description: Return the keys of a JSON object in canonical code-point-sorted order. The result is a fresh list; missing, null, array, and scalar inputs return an empty list.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts reading JSON keys when execution reaches this node.

inputs.name: object
inputs.description: JSON object whose keys should be copied. Non-object values produce an empty list.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the keys have been collected.

outputs.name: keys
outputs.description: Returns a fresh list containing the object's keys in canonical code-point-sorted order.

description: Merge two JSON objects by top-level keys into a fresh map with recursively detached canonical copies. Values from the second object replace duplicate keys; nested objects and lists are detached recursively, and non-object inputs are ignored.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts the JSON merge when execution reaches this node.

inputs.name: object1
inputs.description: First JSON object to copy recursively into the fresh detached result. Non-object input is ignored.

inputs.name: object2
inputs.description: Second JSON object to copy recursively after Object 1. Its values replace duplicate keys; non-object input is ignored.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the shallow merge completes.

outputs.name: merged
outputs.description: Returns a fresh recursively detached map. Duplicate keys use Object 2 values, and nested objects and lists are copied through the canonical JSON form.

description: Create a fresh empty JSON object map. The result is independent from every previous execution and is ready for validated JSON values.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts creating the JSON object when execution reaches this node.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after a fresh JSON object is created.

outputs.name: object
outputs.description: Returns a fresh empty JSON object map.

description: Create a fresh JSON array list from the supplied values. The list is recursively detached through the canonical JSON form; cycles, non-finite numbers, values outside the canonical JSON contract, or values that cannot be validated as JSON fail.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts creating the JSON array when execution reaches this node.

inputs.name: values
inputs.description: Values to copy recursively into the fresh detached array. Cycles, non-finite numbers, values outside the canonical JSON contract, or invalid JSON values fail.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the JSON array is created successfully.

outputs.name: array
outputs.description: Returns a fresh recursively detached copy of the values as a JSON array.
